shared_elements: low-relief carved figures on a flat stone surface
quadruped with four legs shown in side view
repeated row of similar figures along a band
justification: Both show low-relief animals in profile arranged partly in horizontal registers, and both include a repeated row of similar creatures along an upper band, but this is generic register-based relief practice. A depicts a narrative human scene—archers, a chariot with spoked wheel, harnessed horses, marching soldiers with weapons—whereas B is a non-narrative assemblage of isolated animals (a snarling quadruped facing down, birds, a bird with wing spread, small animals) with no humans, no action between figures, and a pillar-shaped field rather than a continuous frieze.
